chains.rationale: The evaluator directly reports the absence of the required correctly addressed and worded SMS. The frozen chain shows the target preserved the false conclusion that a departure time had been found and proceeded toward sending purported information instead of the conditional fallback. The independently frozen event-time-misread-as-departure-time defect is also sufficient to explain this failure, so strong linkage is unavailable.

summary: The evaluator reports that the required fallback SMS was not found. The frozen strict-MHR chain continuously preserved the false departure-time conclusion and redirected the target away from that fallback, although an independently frozen event-time misreading remains a sufficient alternative failure defect.
